units.text: I coordinated our office move and labelled all boxes and cables for 30 employees.
I held usage reviews every 3 months with my 20 key accounts based on CRM data and offered add-on services; revenue from these accounts grew by 18% in a year.
I added root-cause tags to the ticket form and built a monthly Excel report of repeat issues, which I used to decide which knowledge base articles to update.
